issue.title: SASE refuses Git mutations outside a linked checkout's own worktree
issue.description: guard: in the sase repo, make linked and sidecar materialization verify that a reused path is a Git worktree rooted at itself before any origin rewrite, fetch, merge, or exclude write, and make the push path refuse a checkout whose toplevel or origin is not the one SASE expects, with regression tests.

payload.entry: RESTORE GATE PREPARED: No prior phase work had landed. Live master 5e29dd26 includes three genuine Mac commits (b20ceca5, 3fb3a2be, 5e29dd26); replay onto 29147289 passes author/date and tree fidelity checks on all 52 changed paths. Local bare-mirror and cp -a checkout rehearsals passed with the exact bundled shell command: clean and harmless-dirty branches moved, dirty/untracked bytes and stash retained, conflicting edits and unique local commits preserved/reported, enclosing-host fake checkout skipped, polluted CI branch deleted while clean CI branch retained. Merge and concurrent-master lease refusal checks passed; already-restored master refuses rerun. Read-only surveys reached athena/apollo/mac: 3/1/1 polluted checkouts respectively, all working trees clean. The approved plan explicitly requires a human gate before force-pushing; preparing that gate now. No shared-history push or live checkout cleanup has run. Gate continuation owns remote/checkout verification, docs-check, exact-SHA macOS CI via monitor, real SHA mapping notes, epic-symbol check, and closing only this phase. Scratch source/evidence: /tmp/bob-cli-jf-restore-prep; scripts and rehearsal results are embedded in the durable gate bundle. This is the planned approval handoff, not unfinished coding scope requiring a child epic.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: External repo reuse can accept its enclosing host checkout — src/sase/main/repo_open_external.py::_is_valid_git_repo uses rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree without a ceiling or root comparison. A local git-init host with an empty sase/repos/external/gh/example/child returns true for that child while show-toplevel is the host. This phase guards publication and linked/sidecar materialization; migrate the external-open validator to the new shared worktree-root probe as a separate follow-up.

payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Full-suite agent-state tests fail intermittently — ToolRun 1ff97e7d77df29ca1443b8d36fbfb1d8 failed test_normal_dismiss_reconciles_unloaded_agent_session_members_after_root_delete (two dismissed timestamps remained visible) and test_production_paths_keep_parity_with_marker_only_population (49 missing production rows). Both pass when rerun with unchanged production code and also pass on clean base bd97664e07f78922f4f9803cb5688ba0b425f6fd in an isolated worktree using the same core 0.44.2 wheel. Investigate suite-order or shared-state sensitivity; no owner was identified by ToolRun triage.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Publication-output test fails for long checkout paths — tests/test_commit_workflow_publication_outcomes.py::test_publication_without_target_warns_but_keeps_primary_successful failed identically at line 308 on both this guard tree and clean base bd97664e07f78922f4f9803cb5688ba0b425f6fd using the same test environment; Rich wraps the repository path, so the whitespace-normalized captured output does not contain the original contiguous path. Recorded by check ToolRun 1ff97e7d77df29ca1443b8d36fbfb1d8; no existing owner was identified by triage. This unrelated baseline assertion does not block the guard phase.

Implemented checkout-root and expected-origin guards in the opened sase repo. Real local Git regressions verify nested non-checkouts cannot alter host origin, refs, or excludes; empty targets clone cleanly; nonempty targets are preserved; valid reuse, origin healing, sidecar cutover, worktree gitfiles and equivalent URL transports remain supported; wrong-origin/pushurl publication and retry are refused. Final focused verification: 117 passed in 9.46s; Ruff, format and diff checks pass. Required check ToolRun 1ff97e7d77df29ca1443b8d36fbfb1d8 passed whole-repo lint/validation and ran the full suite (16510 passed, 8 failed, 8 skipped): fixed all five affected mock failures and reran their modules successfully; two intermittent agent-state failures pass on rerun and clean base, and the publication-output failure reproduces on clean base bd97664e07. Those verification issues and the external-open validator discovery are recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes. No epic-symbol entries remain. No ancestor bead closed; no memory or Rust source changes.
